name: Der Maniac Moose
notes: Known from a post to rec.sport.pro-wrestling of 23 December 1994 and the champion's reply of the same day that quotes it whole, served at /promotions/rspwf-parody-1994/archive/rswpf-re-re-special-update-2-1994-12-23.html and /promotions/rspwf-parody-1994/archive/rswpf-re-re-special-update-2-1994-12-23-2.html: a challenger in the RSPWF's December 1994 title feud: in a promo, after the champion accepted his challenge, he mocks the belt won in a nothing-happening melon-farmer town, offers to let the commissioner name the match (an electric barbed-wire cage match or a Santa's bag match) and demands a place on Winter Washout.
caption: A challenger who answers an RSPWF champion in December 1994 and demands a place on Winter Washout.

tenures.source: The challenger's own promo of 23 December 1994 under the fed's [RSWPF] thread tag ('I want on Winter Washout to show what can I do') and the champion's reply of the same day, which quotes it whole and accepts the challenge. Served at /promotions/rspwf-parody-1994/archive/rswpf-re-re-special-update-2-1994-12-23.html and /promotions/rspwf-parody-1994/archive/rswpf-re-re-special-update-2-1994-12-23-2.html.

name: Ideen Barimani
notes: Known from one post to rec.sport.pro-wrestling (23 December 1994), served at /promotions/rspwf-parody-1994/archive/rswpf-re-re-special-update-2-1994-12-23-2.html: a champion of the RSPWF in its December 1994 feud with Der Maniac Moose: in a promo of 23 December 1994 he calls himself the franchise and the hardcore of the hardcores, accepts the challenge, will take any stipulation the commissioner sets and derides the challenger as a stiff who works with chin-locks.
caption: An RSPWF champion who answers the Maniac Moose's challenge in December 1994, billing himself the franchise and the hardcore of the hardcores.

tenures.source: His own promo of 23 December 1994 under the fed's [RSWPF] thread tag, a champion answering the Maniac Moose ('I accept your challenge'; 'I am the most fightingest champion there is'). Served at /promotions/rspwf-parody-1994/archive/rswpf-re-re-special-update-2-1994-12-23-2.html.
